title: Make the client-bundles build reproducible, or stop renewing its manifest
checklist: Reproduce the mismatch: the CI materialize step prints shasum WARNING 40 computed checksums did NOT match against the committed MANIFEST

Establish the cause: build-client-bundles.sh regenerates MANIFEST.sha256 from its own output and ensure-client-bundles.sh then verifies against it, so a cold run self-confirms and cannot detect non-reproducibility
Fix it either way: make the build byte-reproducible, or commit the manifest the build actually produces
Once reproducible, the official-web cache hits for the npm half too, removing the 230 s rebuild from dev/android and the larger one from release/ios
